- Duration: We can commit to the requested 6-month guaranteed allocation with automatic re-evaluation at day 150; recommend language for a one-time extension by mutual written consent.
- Billing/proration: Redwood's standard practice is to prorate at the daily rate of the newly executed CO effective date. If OliveHealth wants retroactive credit to the beginning of Sept, we will need procurement approval and finance sign-off (I flagged this to Kimberly).
- Operational constraints: Shifting units between "burst" and "guaranteed" may require an infra reconfiguration and a brief window of reduced throughput during cutover — Ops must schedule during low-traffic hours.

Attached: Redline_ExhibitB_20260911.docx (contains inline comments and proposed CO language).
